title_or_table: 2024 House campaigns, money in and out through one node, summed from the FEC’s current campaigns file
table_id: Current campaigns for House and Senate, 2023-2024 (webl24)
observation_period: 2023 to 2024 election cycle, through each campaign’s last report (coverage end dates mostly December 31, 2024)
universe_or_base: All 1926 House candidates in the file, primary losers included
unit: dollars, summed and stored to the cent
qualification: No dollar received is traced to a dollar spent: the node is all House campaigns together. Loans and their repayments are their own lines, so a loan is not read as a gift. Transfers between a candidate’s own committees are netted candidate by candidate: 436 candidates took in more from their other committees than they sent them ($175,103,772.47 net, on the in side) and 84 sent more than they took ($18,313,248.58 net, on the out side). Cash at the start plus receipts comes to $2,626,481,617.75; spending, refunds, repayments, transfers and cash at the end come to $2,624,948,459.72; the remainder, $1,533,158.03, is the figures of 297 of the 1,926 campaigns that do not balance in the file (cash at the start plus receipts, less disbursements and cash at the end), $1,500,000.00 of it from one campaign. The file gives no cause.

side.description: in or out of the node

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Election Commission, current campaigns for House and Senate file, 2023 to 2024 cycle, all House candidates. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Summed by Oath & Action; no receipt is traced to a disbursement.
derivation: Sums of the file’s columns over every House candidate; other receipts and spending are totals less the named lines; transfers between a candidate’s own committees are netted candidate by candidate, each candidate’s net transfers in summed on the in side and net transfers out on the out side.
notes: In: 2,626,481,617.75; out: 2,624,948,459.72; remainder: 1,533,158.03 (0.058 percent of the in side). Receipts with cash at the start left out: 2,271,178,361.46; individuals 1,384,115,131.69, 60.9 percent of them.

The remainder, by campaign (ST-S2, November 13, 2026): 297 of the 1,926 campaigns do not balance, 167 leaving more in than out ($2,799,022.51) and 130 less ($1,265,864.48). One campaign, H4IN05195, whose last report in the file covers through April 30, 2024, leaves $1,500,000.00, 97.8 percent of the net remainder; the other 296 leave $33,158.03 net, from $1,299,022.51 over and $1,265,864.48 under. The chart names no candidate.

Transfers netted candidate by candidate since November 13, 2026 (ST-S2): before, the file netted them across all 1,926 campaigns at once ($156,790,523.89 in, $0.00 out), which set one campaign’s transfers out against another’s transfers in. Money in and out each grow by $18,313,248.58; the remainder does not move.
